title: Argumentation-Based Person-Tailored Storytelling for Older Adults: A Reflective Hybrid AI Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2605.10531v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This work investigates knowledge-driven, large language model (LLM)-based storytelling for older adults. We present a reflective storytelling agent integrating knowledge graphs, user modelling, and argumentation theory to guide person-tailored narratives. Argument mining supports inspection of argument structure, while persona grounding is assessed separately against structured information.   The study comprised three phases. Phase I involved 11 domain experts whose feedback informed system refinement. Phase II involved 55 older adults evaluating narratives based on predefined personas across inquiry, deliberation, and persuasion purposes and two creativity levels. Phase III compared the full system with an argumentation-scheme ablation and standard LLM baseline, and validated zero-shot argument mining against human-consensus annotations.   In Phase II, the intended purpose was recognised in 30.6% of 330 assessments; 33.3% indicated

translated_title: 基于论证的面向老年人个性化叙事：一种反思性混合AI架构
translated_abstract: 本工作研究了面向老年人的知识驱动、基于大语言模型（LLM）的叙事方法。我们提出了一种反思性叙事智能体，该智能体整合了知识图谱、用户建模和论证理论，以指导个性化叙事的生成。论证挖掘支持对论证结构的检查，而角色设定的依据则对照结构化信息进行单独评估。该研究分为三个阶段：第一阶段邀请了11位领域专家，其反馈用于系统的改进；第二阶段邀请了55位老年人，基于预定义的角色画像，从探究、审议和说服三种叙事目的以及两个创造力水平对叙事进行评估；第三阶段将完整系统与去除论证图式的消融版本以及标准LLM基线进行对比，并依据人类共识标注验证了零样本论证挖掘的效果。在第二阶段，330次评估中有30.6%正确识别出了预期的叙事目的；33.3%的评估表明……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合知识图谱、用户建模与论证理论的反思性混合AI叙事智能体，能够为老年人生成个性化叙事，并通过包含55位老年人参与的三阶段实证研究验证了系统在目的传达与论证结构方面的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a reflective hybrid AI storytelling agent that integrates knowledge graphs, user modelling, and argumentation theory to generate person-tailored narratives for older adults, validated through a three-phase study involving 55 older adult evaluators.
